distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is three longitudinal quilted vanes join along a common axis; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish three longitudinal quilted vanes join along a common axis in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以三片纵向绗缝叶瓣沿共同轴相连搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

assets.uncertainty: The source supports the named form; coloration, posture, soft tissues and fine proportions are not all established. Affinity or whole-body reconstruction is debated; the practical catalog grouping is not a settled phylogenetic claim.
